Header: Othreis fulloniaTamil: Palamurinchi anthu; Sinhala: Gedi widina Salambaya

Prevention: Bagging mature fruits with hard brown paper
Smoking of the orchard at night
Citronella oil to the plant as a repellent
Monitoring: Monitor the field regularly for adult moth (adult moth is active at night from 11pm -2am)
Observe a brown, circular, rotten area that develops around the tiny puncture hole on the fruit
There is no larvae inside of the fruit
Direct Control: Destroy the larva in host plant through burning
Erythrina indica tree canopy during the summer (season for laying egg)
